```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

## Defining the parameters
n_students <- 18
n_months <- 10
drift <- 0.05
variation <- 0.12

## Generating initial test results
initial_scores <- rnorm(n_students, mean = 0, sd = 0.1) 

## Creating a matrix of changes for every student per
monthly_changes <- matrix(rnorm(n_students * n_months, mean = drift, sd = variation), 
                          nrow = n_months, ncol = n_students)

## Adding the initial scores to the matrix
scores <- rbind(initial_scores, monthly_changes)

## Using cumulative sum for each column in our matrix
cumulative_scores <- apply(scores, 2, cumsum)

## Add the timeline (0-10 months)
months <- 0:n_months


## "Casting" to data frame 
scores_df <- as.data.frame(cumulative_scores)
scores_df$Month <- months
scores_long <- pivot_longer(scores_df, cols = -Month, names_to = "Student", values_to = "Score")

## Creating the first graph: X = month, Y = test score
p1 <- ggplot(scores_long, aes(x = Month, y = Score, group = Student, color = Student)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Student Progress Over 10 Months", 
       y = "Test Score (Cumulative)", x = "Month") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

# Creating the second graph - A Histogram for test scores
final_scores <- cumulative_scores[nrow(cumulative_scores), ]
p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(Score = final_scores), aes(x = Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Final Scores (Month 10)", 
       y = "Count", x = "Final Score") +
  theme_minimal()

library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```
